ActivityPattern.name: Activity Pattern
ActivityPattern.description: Object-backed reusable professional activity pattern inside a WorkflowPattern. It expresses what should be done at an atomic professional-process level, not a data-science problem/task category. It is distinct from ProblemType and from OMM TaskType, which remains the M1 control-contract anchor.

properties.name: activityOrder
properties.description: Recommended order of an ActivityPattern when a simple linear order exists.
properties.valueTypeDescription: Integer value greater than or equal to zero.

properties.name: guidance
properties.description: Lightweight local advice attached to a pattern or transition. Advice requiring independent provenance, cross-pattern reuse, applicability semantics, validation or evolution SHOULD be externalized as Guideline/ReferenceClaim.

properties.name: pitfalls
properties.description: Lightweight local summary of mistakes or failure risks. Reusable or evidence-governed pitfalls SHOULD be externalized as Guideline/ReferenceClaim with explicit provenance and applicability.

ClaimResource.name: Claim Resource
ClaimResource.description: Abstract proposition-bearing resource shared by ReferenceClaim, InsightCandidate and CoreInsight so that theoretical and evidence-grounded knowledge have a common claim abstraction.

properties.name: claimStatement
properties.description: Canonical proposition expressed by ReferenceClaim, InsightCandidate or CoreInsight.

properties.name: claimKind
properties.description: Semantic function of the claim.
properties.valueTypeDescription: Semantic function of a reusable or empirical claim.

properties.name: applicabilitySummary
properties.description: Concise reusable scope and boundary summary for a claim.

properties.name: resourceVersion
properties.description: Version of a source, implementation, dataset or artifact.

Constraint.name: Constraint
Constraint.description: Normative or machine-checkable ReferenceClaim representing a hard requirement. Empirical evidence may motivate review but cannot silently override it.

properties.name: constraintSeverity
properties.description: Severity of a hard constraint.
properties.valueTypeDescription: Severity of a reusable hard constraint.

properties.name: constraintLanguage
properties.description: Optional language identifier for a machine-checkable constraint expression, e.g. SHACL/SPARQL/CEL.

properties.name: constraintExpression
properties.description: Optional machine-checkable expression for a Constraint. Natural-language claimStatement remains the human-readable normative statement.

DataCharacteristic.name: Data Characteristic
DataCharacteristic.description: Reusable analytical dimension for describing data, such as missingness, distribution shape, temporal structure, cardinality, sparsity, leakage risk, or feature relationship. A DataCondition states a concrete reusable condition along such a dimension.

properties.name: characteristicKind
properties.description: Analytical dimension represented by a DataCharacteristic.
properties.valueTypeDescription: Reusable analytical dimension along which data can be characterized.

DataCondition.name: Data Condition
DataCondition.description: Reusable normalized state/condition of data (e.g., high missingness, strong skew, temporal drift) used as an applicability boundary. A quantitative condition MAY reference a DataStatistic and encode an operator/threshold; qualitative conditions remain valid through conditionStatement. It is distinct from OMM ConditionType, which controls Procedure/Action execution semantics.

properties.name: dataConditionKind
properties.description: Category of reusable data condition.
properties.valueTypeDescription: Reusable kind of data condition.

properties.name: conditionStatement
properties.description: Reusable domain/data condition statement at the knowledge-instance level.

properties.name: conditionOperator
properties.description: Optional machine-interpretable operator for a DataCondition based on a numeric DataStatistic.
properties.valueTypeDescription: Machine-interpretable operator for numeric DataCondition thresholds. Qualitative conditions may omit this and rely on conditionStatement.

properties.name: conditionNumericThreshold
properties.description: Optional primary numeric threshold used by a machine-interpretable DataCondition.

properties.name: conditionNumericUpperThreshold
properties.description: Optional upper numeric threshold, used primarily for between/range conditions.

DataStatistic.name: Data Statistic
DataStatistic.description: Reusable quantitative data descriptor such as MissingRate, NullCount, Skewness, Cardinality, ClassImbalanceRatio or DriftScore. It defines what is computed; concrete observed values are DataStatisticMeasurement instances in empirical cases.

properties.name: statisticFormula
properties.description: Optional canonical formula or computation description for a reusable DataStatistic.

properties.name: measurementUnit
properties.description: Measurement unit when applicable.

DomainConcept.name: Domain Concept
DomainConcept.description: Reusable application-domain concept such as wellhead pressure, gas production rate, customer segment, or disease state.

Entity.name: Entity
Entity.description: Abstract identity-bearing base for DSO instance resources.

properties.name: identifier
properties.description: Stable identifier for a DSO instance.

properties.name: displayName
properties.description: Human-readable instance name.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Natural-language description of an instance.

properties.name: alternateName
properties.description: Alternative label, abbreviation, alias, or surface form used for entity normalization and cross-source matching.

properties.name: externalIdentifier
properties.description: Identifier assigned by an external registry, repository, standard, package ecosystem, or source system.

properties.name: canonicalUri
properties.description: Canonical resolvable or stable URI used to align the resource with an external identity when available.

EvaluationProtocol.name: Evaluation Protocol
EvaluationProtocol.description: Reusable evaluation/validation design such as random holdout, group k-fold, time-series split, rolling validation, or leaderboard evaluation. It is separate from Metric: Metric says what is measured; EvaluationProtocol says how the estimate is produced.

properties.name: evaluationProtocolType
properties.description: Family of evaluation or validation protocol.
properties.valueTypeDescription: Reusable family of validation/evaluation design.

properties.name: splitStrategy
properties.description: Normalized description of train/validation/test splitting or resampling strategy.

properties.name: foldCount
properties.description: Number of folds when applicable.
properties.valueTypeDescription: Integer value greater than or equal to zero.

properties.name: leakageControlSummary
properties.description: How the protocol prevents temporal, group, target, or preprocessing leakage.

Guideline.name: Guideline
Guideline.description: Advisory and overridable ReferenceClaim expressing recommendation, selection rule, procedure advice, or best practice under declared applicability conditions.

properties.name: guidelineType
properties.description: Type of Guideline claim.
properties.valueTypeDescription: Kind of reusable advisory statement.

IndustryDomain.name: Industry Domain
IndustryDomain.description: Reusable application-domain area such as gas production, retail, finance, or medicine. This is application semantics, not a data-science task category.

KnowledgeSource.name: Knowledge Source
KnowledgeSource.description: Bibliographic/provenance resource identifying a source document, repository, standard, notebook, code artifact, or expert source. Source authority does not by itself constitute empirical validation.

properties.name: sourceType
properties.description: Provenance source category.
properties.valueTypeDescription: Type of source material used for provenance.

properties.name: sourceUri
properties.description: Resolvable URI when available.

properties.name: citation
properties.description: Human-readable bibliographic or source citation.

properties.name: locator
properties.description: Page, section, cell, notebook block, code range, log range or other precise locator in the source.

properties.name: publicationDate
properties.description: Publication or release date of a source.

properties.name: resourceVersion
properties.description: Version of a source, implementation, dataset or artifact.

properties.name: license
properties.description: License or usage terms.

properties.name: sourceTitle
properties.description: Bibliographic or human-facing title of a knowledge source.

properties.name: authors
properties.description: Canonical author list serialized as text.

properties.name: publisherOrVenue
properties.description: Publisher, journal, conference, repository, or issuing organization.

properties.name: doi
properties.description: Digital Object Identifier when available.

properties.name: isbn
properties.description: ISBN when the source is a book or handbook.

Method.name: Method
Method.description: Reusable conceptual data-science method, algorithm, model family, transformation, analysis, or evaluation technique independent of one concrete implementation or trained artifact.

properties.name: methodPurpose
properties.description: Purpose served by a method.
properties.valueTypeDescription: Primary purpose served by a data-science method.

properties.name: methodParadigm
properties.description: Methodological paradigm.
properties.valueTypeDescription: Methodological paradigm.

properties.name: trainingMode
properties.description: Training or reuse mode.
properties.valueTypeDescription: Training or reuse mode of a method.

properties.name: assumptions
properties.description: Optional compact assumption summary. If an assumption is independently citable, applicability-bearing, reusable, or subject to evidence/knowledge evolution, it SHOULD be externalized as a ReferenceClaim/Guideline linked to the relevant Method or ModelSpecification.

properties.name: limitations
properties.description: Optional compact limitation summary. Reusable or evidence-governed limitations SHOULD be externalized as ReferenceClaim/Guideline objects with explicit provenance and applicability.

properties.name: resourceRequirements
properties.description: Typical computational or software requirements.

MethodImplementation.name: Method Implementation
MethodImplementation.description: Reusable implementation knowledge for a Method, such as a library class, function or model-repository artifact. Distinct from OMM ActionType, which is an executable capability contract.

properties.name: implementationType
properties.description: Packaging form of an implementation.
properties.valueTypeDescription: Technical packaging of a method implementation.

properties.name: implementationVersion
properties.description: Version of a concrete method implementation.

properties.name: programmingLanguage
properties.description: Programming language of an implementation.

properties.name: callablePath
properties.description: Import path, command or endpoint identifier.

properties.name: invocationTemplate
properties.description: Illustrative non-runtime-bound invocation template.

properties.name: parameterSchema
properties.description: Canonical serialized parameter schema.

properties.name: inputSchema
properties.description: Canonical serialized input contract.

properties.name: outputSchema
properties.description: Canonical serialized output contract.

Metric.name: Metric
Metric.description: Reusable metric definition describing what is quantified; evaluation protocol is modeled separately.

properties.name: metricDirection
properties.description: Optimization direction of a metric.
properties.valueTypeDescription: Optimization direction of a metric.

properties.name: metricFormula
properties.description: Human- or machine-readable formula description.

properties.name: measurementUnit
properties.description: Measurement unit when applicable.

ModelSpecification.name: Model Specification
ModelSpecification.description: Reusable normalized model-level specification that is more concrete than a conceptual Method but is not a case-trained ModelArtifact. It may be derived from architecture specifications, model-card fragments, repository metadata or pretrained checkpoint families. A complete Method Card is a retrieval/aggregation view, not this ObjectType itself.

properties.name: modelSpecificationType
properties.description: Kind of reusable model specification or repository asset.
properties.valueTypeDescription: Kind of reusable model-level specification or repository asset.

properties.name: architectureSummary
properties.description: Normalized architecture or estimator configuration summary.

properties.name: parameterCount
properties.description: Approximate trainable/total parameter count where meaningful.
properties.valueTypeDescription: Integer value greater than or equal to zero.

properties.name: repositoryUri
properties.description: Canonical model/repository location when the reusable asset is externally hosted.

properties.name: modelCardUri
properties.description: Location of a model card or equivalent documentation.

properties.name: pretrainingSummary
properties.description: Summary of pretraining data/objective when applicable.

properties.name: fineTuningSupport
properties.description: Whether the reusable model specification supports fine-tuning.

ProblemType.name: Problem Type
ProblemType.description: Reusable data-science task archetype (e.g., regression, classification, forecasting) separated from application-domain semantics.

properties.name: problemCategory
properties.description: Canonical problem category.
properties.valueTypeDescription: Canonical data-science problem family.

properties.name: objectiveStatement
properties.description: Formal objective of a concrete or reusable problem definition.

properties.name: successCriteria
properties.description: Success condition beyond the metric formula itself.

ReferenceClaim.name: Reference Claim
ReferenceClaim.description: Reusable source-grounded proposition extracted from textbooks, standards, documentation, application-domain sources, or research literature. It is a normalized semantic assertion rather than a document summary. Its epistemic status describes standing in the reference corpus; empirical case validation is modeled separately through EvidenceRecord/CoreInsight.

properties.name: knowledgeOriginRole
properties.description: Whether reusable knowledge originates semantically from data-science knowledge, application-domain knowledge, or their cross-domain intersection. This is not the Problem/Data/Method/Process subject-domain axis.
properties.valueTypeDescription: Semantic origin/context role of reusable knowledge: data-science theory, application-domain knowledge, or their cross-domain intersection. This is orthogonal to the Reference Knowledge subject domains Problem/Data/Method/Process.

properties.name: referenceClaimStatus
properties.description: Epistemic standing of a reusable source-grounded claim in the reference corpus.
properties.valueTypeDescription: Curated epistemic status of a ReferenceClaim within the reference corpus. It describes source-side knowledge standing and MUST NOT be confused with case-based empirical validation.

properties.name: revisionRationale
properties.description: Optional explanation of why a ReferenceClaim revision was created and what changed relative to the prior claim.

ReferenceResource.name: Reference Resource
ReferenceResource.description: Abstract base for reusable semantic resources in reference knowledge. Reference resources are not bound to one empirical case; provenance is linked separately through KnowledgeSource/SourceFragment.

properties.name: knowledgeOriginRole
properties.description: Whether reusable knowledge originates semantically from data-science knowledge, application-domain knowledge, or their cross-domain intersection. This is not the Problem/Data/Method/Process subject-domain axis.
properties.valueTypeDescription: Semantic origin/context role of reusable knowledge: data-science theory, application-domain knowledge, or their cross-domain intersection. This is orthogonal to the Reference Knowledge subject domains Problem/Data/Method/Process.

SoftwareComponent.name: Software Component
SoftwareComponent.description: Reusable software package, module, service or repository component used by implementations.

properties.name: componentType
properties.description: Kind of software component.
properties.valueTypeDescription: Kind of software component.

properties.name: resourceVersion
properties.description: Version of a source, implementation, dataset or artifact.

properties.name: license
properties.description: License or usage terms.

SolutionTemplate.name: Solution Template
SolutionTemplate.description: Reusable high-level solution skeleton for a ProblemType; it organizes reusable stages but is not a concrete case pipeline.

properties.name: templateVersion
properties.description: Version of a reusable solution or workflow pattern.

properties.name: preconditionSummary
properties.description: Human-readable local prerequisite summary for a reusable pattern. Independently reusable or evidence-governed prerequisites SHOULD be represented as ReferenceClaim/Guideline/Constraint objects.

properties.name: postconditionSummary
properties.description: Human-readable local expected-state summary for a reusable pattern. Independently reusable or evidence-governed assertions SHOULD be represented as ReferenceClaim/Guideline/Constraint objects.

SourceFragment.name: Source Fragment
SourceFragment.description: Traceable sub-resource inside a KnowledgeSource. SourceFragment separates structural location (chapter/section/paragraph/table/code block) from semantic role (theory, method, experiment result, standard rule, etc.) and is the preferred grounding unit for extracted knowledge.

properties.name: fragmentType
properties.description: Type of traceable fragment within a source.
properties.valueTypeDescription: Structural granularity of a traceable fragment inside a source.

properties.name: fragmentRole
properties.description: Semantic role of a source fragment for extraction/routing.
properties.valueTypeDescription: Semantic function played by a source fragment during knowledge extraction. This role guides whether the fragment contributes reusable reference knowledge, concrete case facts/evidence, implementation knowledge, or normative rules.

properties.name: fragmentLocator
properties.description: Stable source-local locator such as chapter/section/page/table/figure identifiers.

properties.name: fragmentSummary
properties.description: Short normalized semantic summary of the fragment; not a replacement for provenance.

properties.name: contentHash
properties.description: Optional hash for detecting source-fragment changes across ingestion runs.

Stage.name: Stage
Stage.description: Reusable coarse-grained phase of a SolutionTemplate.

properties.name: stageOrder
properties.description: Recommended order of a reusable stage.
properties.valueTypeDescription: Integer value greater than or equal to zero.

TransitionPattern.name: Transition Pattern
TransitionPattern.description: Object-backed reusable transition knowledge inside a WorkflowPattern. It preserves corpus provenance and can be mapped to case transitions.

properties.name: transitionCondition
properties.description: Knowledge-instance-level transition condition text for a workflow pattern.

properties.name: guidance
properties.description: Lightweight local advice attached to a pattern or transition. Advice requiring independent provenance, cross-pattern reuse, applicability semantics, validation or evolution SHOULD be externalized as Guideline/ReferenceClaim.

properties.name: pitfalls
properties.description: Lightweight local summary of mistakes or failure risks. Reusable or evidence-governed pitfalls SHOULD be externalized as Guideline/ReferenceClaim with explicit provenance and applicability.

WorkflowPattern.name: Workflow Pattern
WorkflowPattern.description: Object-backed reusable workflow knowledge extracted or curated from reference corpora. It supports provenance, case mapping and evidence relations. It is deliberately distinct from OMM ProcedureType, which is an M1 executable/control contract.

properties.name: templateVersion
properties.description: Version of a reusable solution or workflow pattern.

properties.name: preconditionSummary
properties.description: Human-readable local prerequisite summary for a reusable pattern. Independently reusable or evidence-governed prerequisites SHOULD be represented as ReferenceClaim/Guideline/Constraint objects.

properties.name: postconditionSummary
properties.description: Human-readable local expected-state summary for a reusable pattern. Independently reusable or evidence-governed assertions SHOULD be represented as ReferenceClaim/Guideline/Constraint objects.

resourceHasSource.name: Resource Has Source
resourceHasSource.description: Links any DSO instance resource to source provenance. This relation does not assert empirical validation.

sourceHasFragment.name: Source Has Fragment
sourceHasFragment.description: Decomposes a source into traceable fragments. Every SourceFragment belongs to exactly one KnowledgeSource; a source may have zero or many fragments.

fragmentPartOfFragment.name: Fragment Part Of Fragment
fragmentPartOfFragment.description: Represents nested source structure such as paragraph within section or section within chapter. A fragment may have at most one immediate parent; a parent may contain many child fragments.

resourceGroundedInFragment.name: Resource Grounded In Fragment
resourceGroundedInFragment.description: Links a reusable semantic resource or claim to the exact source fragment from which it was extracted or normalized.

claimGroundedInFragment.name: Claim Grounded In Fragment
claimGroundedInFragment.description: Provides claim-level fine-grained provenance. A claim should prefer this relation over whole-document-only provenance when a stable fragment is available.

referenceClaimRevisionOf.name: Reference Claim Revision Of
referenceClaimRevisionOf.description: Links a newer curated ReferenceClaim to at most one immediate prior ReferenceClaim version, preserving reference-evolution lineage.

domainConceptInIndustryDomain.name: Domain Concept In Industry Domain
domainConceptInIndustryDomain.description: Places a DomainConcept in one or more IndustryDomains.

industryDomainBroaderDomain.name: Industry Domain Broader Domain
industryDomainBroaderDomain.description: Optional reusable hierarchy between application domains.

domainConceptBroaderConcept.name: Domain Concept Broader Concept
domainConceptBroaderConcept.description: Optional broader/narrower hierarchy among reusable application-domain concepts.

problemTypeInIndustryDomain.name: Problem Type In Industry Domain
problemTypeInIndustryDomain.description: Associates a reusable ProblemType with an application domain.

problemTypeBroaderProblemType.name: Problem Type Broader Problem Type
problemTypeBroaderProblemType.description: Allows domain-scoped task archetypes such as gas-well production forecasting to specialize broader data-science problem types such as forecasting.

problemTypeUsesDomainConcept.name: Problem Type Uses Domain Concept
problemTypeUsesDomainConcept.description: Identifies domain concepts relevant to a reusable problem archetype.

problemTypeEvaluatedByMetric.name: Problem Type Evaluated By Metric
problemTypeEvaluatedByMetric.description: Links a reusable problem archetype to suitable metrics.

problemTypeUsesEvaluationProtocol.name: Problem Type Uses Evaluation Protocol
problemTypeUsesEvaluationProtocol.description: Associates reusable task types with commonly applicable evaluation protocols without making the protocol mandatory for every case.

dataConditionUsesDomainConcept.name: Data Condition Uses Domain Concept
dataConditionUsesDomainConcept.description: Specializes a reusable data condition with application-domain semantics when needed.

dataConditionCharacterizes.name: Data Condition Characterizes
dataConditionCharacterizes.description: Associates a normalized DataCondition with the reusable DataCharacteristic dimension it constrains.

dataStatisticMeasuresCharacteristic.name: Data Statistic Measures Characteristic
dataStatisticMeasuresCharacteristic.description: Links a reusable quantitative DataStatistic to the DataCharacteristic dimension it operationalizes.

dataConditionBasedOnStatistic.name: Data Condition Based On Statistic
dataConditionBasedOnStatistic.description: Optionally grounds a quantitative DataCondition in the reusable DataStatistic whose measurement is compared with its threshold.

dataCharacteristicBroaderCharacteristic.name: Data Characteristic Broader Characteristic
dataCharacteristicBroaderCharacteristic.description: Optional hierarchy among reusable data-characteristic dimensions.

dataConditionRefinesDataCondition.name: Data Condition Refines Data Condition
dataConditionRefinesDataCondition.description: Expresses a more specific reusable data condition relative to a broader condition without turning the condition into a case observation.

claimInIndustryDomain.name: Claim In Industry Domain
claimInIndustryDomain.description: Scopes a reusable claim or insight to an IndustryDomain.

claimConcernsProblemType.name: Claim Concerns Problem Type
claimConcernsProblemType.description: Links a claim to a problem type it defines, characterizes, compares, or otherwise discusses; this is distinct from applicability.

claimConcernsDomainConcept.name: Claim Concerns Domain Concept
claimConcernsDomainConcept.description: Scopes a claim or insight to relevant application-domain concepts.

claimConcernsDataCharacteristic.name: Claim Concerns Data Characteristic
claimConcernsDataCharacteristic.description: Links a reusable claim to the data characteristic dimension it discusses.

claimConcernsDataCondition.name: Claim Concerns Data Condition
claimConcernsDataCondition.description: Links a claim to a DataCondition it explicitly describes or reasons about; applicabilityUnder remains a separate relation.

claimConcernsMetric.name: Claim Concerns Metric
claimConcernsMetric.description: Links a reusable claim to an evaluation metric it defines, compares, limits, or recommends.

claimConcernsEvaluationProtocol.name: Claim Concerns Evaluation Protocol
claimConcernsEvaluationProtocol.description: Links a reusable claim to validation/evaluation protocol knowledge.

claimAppliesToProblemType.name: Claim Applies To Problem Type
claimAppliesToProblemType.description: Scopes a claim to one or more reusable problem types.

claimAppliesUnderDataCondition.name: Claim Applies Under Data Condition
claimAppliesUnderDataCondition.description: States reusable data conditions under which a claim applies.

claimExcludedUnderDataCondition.name: Claim Excluded Under Data Condition
claimExcludedUnderDataCondition.description: Declares a reusable data condition under which a ClaimResource must not be treated as applicable.

claimConcernsMethod.name: Claim Concerns Method
claimConcernsMethod.description: Associates a claim with a Method.

claimConcernsModelSpecification.name: Claim Concerns Model Specification
claimConcernsModelSpecification.description: Links claims from model cards, repositories, papers, or documentation to reusable model specifications.

claimConcernsMethodImplementation.name: Claim Concerns Method Implementation
claimConcernsMethodImplementation.description: Links implementation-specific claims to callable/API/repository implementations.

claimConcernsSoftwareComponent.name: Claim Concerns Software Component
claimConcernsSoftwareComponent.description: Links documentation, compatibility, version, or implementation claims to software components.

claimConcernsSolutionTemplate.name: Claim Concerns Solution Template
claimConcernsSolutionTemplate.description: Associates a claim with a reusable SolutionTemplate.

claimAppliesToStage.name: Claim Applies To Stage
claimAppliesToStage.description: Associates a claim with a reusable Stage.

claimConcernsStage.name: Claim Concerns Stage
claimConcernsStage.description: Links a claim to a Stage it defines or discusses, distinct from the claim being applicable at that stage.

claimConcernsWorkflowPattern.name: Claim Concerns Workflow Pattern
claimConcernsWorkflowPattern.description: Associates a claim with a reusable object-backed WorkflowPattern.

claimConcernsActivityPattern.name: Claim Concerns Activity Pattern
claimConcernsActivityPattern.description: Associates a claim with a reusable ActivityPattern; claims remain first-class proposition objects rather than being embedded only as activity text.

methodBroaderMethod.name: Method Broader Method
methodBroaderMethod.description: Represents method taxonomy without assuming transitive reasoning in RelationType semantics.

modelSpecificationSpecifiesMethod.name: Model Specification Specifies Method
modelSpecificationSpecifiesMethod.description: Associates a reusable normalized model specification, possibly derived from model-card or repository metadata, with the conceptual method or model family it concretizes.

implementationImplementsMethod.name: Implementation Implements Method
implementationImplementsMethod.description: Links a reusable technical implementation to the conceptual Method it implements.

implementationUsesSoftwareComponent.name: Implementation Uses Software Component
implementationUsesSoftwareComponent.description: Links a method implementation to required software components.

implementationConformsToModelSpecificati.name: Implementation Conforms To Model Specification
implementationConformsToModelSpecificati.description: Links an implementation entry to a reusable model specification when the implementation realizes a particular architecture/configuration/asset.

modelSpecificationUsesSoftwareComponent.name: Model Specification Uses Software Component
modelSpecificationUsesSoftwareComponent.description: Associates a reusable model specification with libraries, repositories, modules, or services required to obtain or use it.

methodApplicableToProblemType.name: Method Applicable To Problem Type
methodApplicableToProblemType.description: Reusable applicability of a Method to a ProblemType.

methodApplicableUnderDataCondition.name: Method Applicable Under Data Condition
methodApplicableUnderDataCondition.description: Reusable applicability of a Method under a DataCondition.

methodExcludedUnderDataCondition.name: Method Excluded Under Data Condition
methodExcludedUnderDataCondition.description: Declares a reusable data condition that excludes or invalidates normal applicability of a Method.

methodRealizesActivityPattern.name: Method Realizes Activity Pattern
methodRealizesActivityPattern.description: Links a conceptual Method to the reusable ActivityPattern(s) it can realize. ActivityPattern answers what should be done; Method answers the general way to do it.

solutionTemplateApplicableToProblemType.name: Solution Template Applicable To Problem Type
solutionTemplateApplicableToProblemType.description: Scopes a solution template to reusable problem archetypes.

solutionTemplateIncludesStage.name: Solution Template Includes Stage
solutionTemplateIncludesStage.description: Composes a high-level solution template from reusable stages.

stageContainsWorkflowPattern.name: Stage Contains Workflow Pattern
stageContainsWorkflowPattern.description: Places reusable workflow patterns in a stage.

workflowPatternContainsActivityPattern.name: Workflow Pattern Contains Activity Pattern
workflowPatternContainsActivityPattern.description: Composes an object-backed WorkflowPattern from reusable ActivityPatterns.

workflowPatternContainsTransitionPattern.name: Workflow Pattern Contains Transition Pattern
workflowPatternContainsTransitionPattern.description: Composes an object-backed workflow pattern from reusable transition patterns.

transitionPatternSourceActivity.name: Transition Pattern Source Task
transitionPatternSourceActivity.description: Source task of an object-backed transition pattern.

transitionPatternTargetActivity.name: Transition Pattern Target Task
transitionPatternTargetActivity.description: Target task of an object-backed transition pattern.

workflowPatternApplicableToProblemType.name: Workflow Pattern Applicable To Problem Type
workflowPatternApplicableToProblemType.description: Scopes workflow patterns to reusable problem types.

workflowPatternApplicableUnderDataCondit.name: Workflow Pattern Applicable Under Data Condition
workflowPatternApplicableUnderDataCondit.description: Scopes workflow patterns to reusable data conditions.

workflowPatternExcludedUnderDataConditio.name: Workflow Pattern Excluded Under Data Condition
workflowPatternExcludedUnderDataConditio.description: Declares a data condition under which a WorkflowPattern should not be considered applicable.
